name: Dream
description:
Casting time: 1 minute.

Choose a creature you can name. You enter a trance, becoming senseless to your actual surroundings. If the chosen creature is asleep, you appear to them in their dreams. For the next hour, you may interact and communicate with them as normal, moving with them as they dream and shaping the environment of the dream as you choose. You may emerge from the trance at any time as a free action.

If the creature is not asleep when you cast the spell, you learn that information, the spell ends, and you regain half the MP spent to cast it, rounded up.

Describe the dream.

improvements.name: Nightmare
improvements.description: When you shape the dream, you can turn it into a terrifying nightmare. When you do, roll Awe vs Spirit against the target. On a win, the target does not gain the benefits of its current rest and checks a Condition. On a loss, the target just checks a Condition.

improvements.name: Inception
improvements.description:
While in the creature's dream, if it can understand you, you may attempt to convince it that it is dreaming, to trust you, and that falling asleep within the dream will wake it. Roll Insight vs Awareness against the creature three times:

  • On the first loss, the creature becomes lucid, recognizes you as an intruder, and seizes control of the dream. You lose control of the environment. The creature can shape the dream freely, fly, and command other dream creatures.

  • On three wins, the creature is convinced, trusts you, and willingly falls asleep within the dream. If you do the same, you both enter a deeper dream.

The deeper dream is formed from the people, places, and memories most important to the creature, which appears within it with no memory of the previous dream.

Within this deeper dream, you may again attempt to gain the creature's trust, rolling Insight vs Awareness three times:

  • On the first loss, the creature becomes lucid as before, but the dream immediately becomes unstable, extreme, and hostile under their control.

  • On three wins, the creature trusts you. It will either reveal a closely held secret or accept a suggested idea, which it will believe to be their own upon waking.

For any of these rolls, a result that produces 🌞 counts as two successes on a win, or converts a loss into a win.

If you are killed in the dream, the spell ends, you emerge from the trance and check a Condition. If if you are killed in the deeper dream, you cannot uncheck that Condition for 1 year, and you gain 1d4 Shadow.

improvements.name: Messenger
improvements.description: You may send a willing creature you touch into the dream instead. The creature has the same powers you would have if you were in the dream.
